plugins.name: hi-claude
plugins.description: A working method for Claude Code: seven principles on four axes with the hierarchy that settles them, governed memory, a curated CLAUDE.md, a register of open work that survives compaction, every content with a declared destination instead of a new file, text that gets pruned when it stops being true, subagents that investigate and never decide, an inventory of what the project can use, and a turn that does not end with the register stale.
